articles.title: ECON 650 - In Class Exercise 8
articles.contents:
Question 1


# Create the vector x
x = c(1, 3, 5, 8, 10 , 14, 2, TRUE, FALSE, 1)

# Show the vector x
x

 [1]  1  3  5  8 10 14  2  1  0  1

# Check if the vector is numeric
is.numeric(x)

[1] TRUE

Question 2


# Convert vector x to a character vector, keep the same name
x = as.character(x)

# Show the new x vector
x

 [1] "1"  "3"  "5"  "8"  "10" "14" "2"  "1"  "0"  "1" 

# Show the new x vector type
typeof(x)

[1] "character"

Question 3


# Create a new vector y that includes elements in x that are not equal to 1
y = x[x!="1"] # "1" as a chr since x is a chr right now

# Show the new vector y
y

[1] "3"  "5"  "8"  "10" "14" "2"  "0" 

Question 4


## Converting vector x to numeric and filling in the matrix by row
Z = matrix(as.numeric(x), 5, 2, byrow = TRUE)

## Showing the matrix Z
Z

     [,1] [,2]
[1,]    1    3
[2,]    5    8
[3,]   10   14
[4,]    2    1
[5,]    0    1

Question 5


# Single command to return the second and fourth element in the second column
Z[c(2,4),2]

[1] 8 1
